title: Rav Assi bar Chiyya

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah 51b, saying: “Whatever is inside the kalkalin, even water and salt, is forbidden.” Hyman says he has found no other mention of him, and Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Shimi bar Chiyya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Avodah Zarah 51b paragraph fully writes Rav Assi bar Chiyya, supporting Rav for the supplied abbreviated ר׳. Hyman’s claim of no other occurrence is his observation, not a new exhaustive search.

The consulted Avodah Zarah 51b explicitly writes Rav Assi bar Chiyya. Hyman’s assertion of no other occurrence remains his observation, not a new exhaustive search. The Dikdukei Soferim reading Rav Shimi bar Chiyya remains his reported variant, not a fresh apparatus collation.
